headline: Google's Genie 4 world model is rolling out as a research preview
body: Google announced Genie 4, a world model with enhanced photorealism and native audio. It is rolling out as a research preview for trusted testers, starting with Google AI Ultra subscribers in Project Genie and early access partners of the Gemini API and Google AI Studio.
note: Google says it is gathering feedback before a wider release, and its own examples are training environments for robots and agents. For banks the link is indirect.

evidence.text: Today, we are announcing Genie 4, our new world model, which unlocks unprecedented realism and improves real-time interactive simulation.
Genie 4 delivers enhanced photorealism, fluid movement, and native audio.
We have started rolling Genie 4 out as a research preview for trusted testers
starting with Google AI Ultra subscribers in Project Genie and early access partners of the Gemini API and Google AI Studio.
gathering feedback before we release it to consumers and developers
Genie 4 advances our ability to create safe, infinitely variable simulations that can help with everything from developing training environments for robots and agents
